title: Venue
description: A place orders can be placed and balances held. Closed object: the supported set is a closed allowlist in code, three times over (backend/api/internal/accounts/exchange/account.go KnownExchange; backend/api/internal/markets/instruments/symbol.go symbol switches; backend/api/internal/accounts/wallets/wallets.go exchangeChains). This schema does not invent a fourth list - `known` says whether THIS build can trade it, and `venue_id` is the canonical handle a mapping table would mint (absent today, see docs/architecture/canonical-model.md D-CANON). A DEX pool is not a Venue for trading purposes in the current repo (no DEX order path exists).

name.description: Display name ('Binance'), never the lowercased key used in code.

kind.description: cex = a venue with an order API; dex = an on-chain venue (pool data only today; not tradable via the executor, whose adapters are binance/bybit/mexc).

known.description: True only if this build's allowlist contains the venue. False means the data may exist but no order may be placed.

market_types.description: Market families this venue is modelled for. Mirrors backend/api/internal/accounts/exchange/account.go KnownExchange plus the instrument MarketType pairs.
